div.head: Cn 1020 15
div.ab: ⁊ eac hy us furðor lærað, þæt we sceolon eallan magene ⁊ eallon myhton þone ecan mildan God inlice secan, lufian ⁊ weorðian ⁊ ælc unriht ascunian, ðæt synd mægslagan ⁊ morðslagan ⁊ mansworan ⁊ wiccean ⁊ wælcyrian ⁊ æwbrecan ⁊ syblegeru.

⁊ eac hy us furðor lærað, þæt we sceolon eallan mægene ⁊ eallon myhton þone ecan mildan God inlice secan, lufian ⁊ weorðian ⁊ ælc unriht ascunian—ðæt synd mægslagan ⁊ morðslagan ⁊ mansworan ⁊ wiccean ⁊ wælcyrian ⁊ æwbrecan ⁊ syblegeru.

And eac hy us furðor lærað, þæt we sceolon eallan magene and eallon myhton þone ecan mildan God inlice secan, lufian and weorðian, and ælc unriht ascunian, ðæt synd mægslagan and morðslagan and mansworan and wiccean and wælcyrian and æwbrecan and syblegeru.

Und ferner lehren sie uns auch, dass wir mit allem Vermögen und aller Macht den ewigen, milden Gott inniglich suchen, lieben und ehren sollen und jedes Unrecht meiden, nämlich Verwandtenmörder und Verüber heimlichen Mords und Meineidige und Hexen[meister?] und Zaubrerinnen und Ehebrecher und Blutschanden.

And further they teach us that we must seek, love and honour the eternal merciful God inwardly with all our strength and all our might, and shun every wrong, namely kin-slayers and murderers and perjurers and witches and sorceresses and adulterers and incest.

And likewise they teach us further that, with all our might and with all our strength, we should fervently seek, love and honour the eternal, merciful God, and put away from us every form of unrighteousness, such as [the deeds of] parricides, murderers, perjurers, witches, sorceresses and adulterers, and incestuous deeds.

And also they teach us further that we must with all our strength and all our might earnestly seek, love and honour the eternal merciful God, and shun all evil-doing, namely [the deeds of] slayers of their kin and murderers, and perjurers and wizards and sorceresses, and adulterers, and incestuous deeds.

In addition, they further instruct us that we should sincerely seek, love, and honor the eternal merciful God with all our power and all our might, and reject all forms of wrongdoing, especially those of parricides, murderers and perjurers, witches, enchantresses, adulterers, and the incestuous.
